ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the line segment $AB=3\text{cm}$. Extend $AB$ to point $C$ such that $BC=2AB$, then extend $BA$ to point $D$ such that $AD=AC$. Find the length of the line segment $BD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $AB = 3\,cm$, and $BC = 2AB$, \\
therefore $BC = 2 \times 3 = 6\,cm$, and $AC = AB + BC = 3 + 6 = 9\,cm$, \\
since $AD = AC = 9\,cm$, \\
therefore $BD = AD + AB = 9 + 3 = \boxed{12}$.
